definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being short, whether in physical length, duration of time, or extent.

examples.english: I was surprised by the shortness of winter days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短|みじか}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel the brevity of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{短|みじか}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧だ。
examples.english: The appeal of this movie is its brevity, so I recommend it even for busy people.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix 〜さ to the adjective ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧ (short), converting it into a noun expressing the degree or quality of shortness. The 〜さ suffix is productive and can be applied to most i-adjectives (e.g., ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧ "length," ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧ "height").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短|みじか}さ: the brevity of life
- ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短|みじか}さ: the shortness of days
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短|みじか}さ: the shortness of time
- {短|みじか}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧: brevity is its appeal

COMMON PATTERNS:
The 〜さ suffix turns i-adjectives into nouns expressing degree or extent. It attaches to the stem (without the final い): ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧ → {短|みじか}さ, ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ → ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧, ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ → ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧.
